page_title: NOT 1-1 BUR | Nottingham Forest v Burnley 18/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by James Trafford.
90+9' Today's referee Robert Jones rightly decides to book Josh Cullen (Burnley) for his harsh tackle.
90+8' The ball is behind the sideline. Connor Roberts (Burnley) takes a throw-in.
90+7' Nottingham are ruled offside.
90+6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from James Trafford stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
90+5' That's a clear yellow card. Connor Roberts (Burnley) goes into the book.
90+4' There's no point in Lyle Foster (Burnley) arguing about the referee's decision as it's an obvious red card for a dangerous tackle.
90+4' A VAR review has confirmed the red card for Lyle Foster (Burnley).
90+3' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Lyle Foster (Burnley)! Let's see what he decides.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Good clearance! Lyle Foster (Burnley) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.

89' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
88' Steven Cooper decides to make a substitution. Taiwo Awoniyi will be replaced by Chris Wood (Nottingham).
88' Substitution. Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) has come on for Jordan Beyer.
85' Sander Berge (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
85' The free kick from long range, taken by Nottingham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Anass Zaroury (Burnley) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matt Turner intercepts the ball.
81' The corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is hurriedly cleared.
80' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
80' Anass Zaroury (Burnley) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matt Turner, who smothers the ball.
78' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Burnley due to a handball in the build-up play.
77' Wait! Referee Robert Jones has indicated he is going to review the Burnley goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.

76' A superb goal from great team play! Lyle Foster (Burnley) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
76' Luca Koleosho will be replaced by Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).
76' None of the Nottingham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
75' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham). Nottingham will take a corner kick.

74' Anass Zaroury (Burnley) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
72' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Callum Hudson-Odoi is replaced by Divock Origi (Nottingham).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ryan Yates (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch so that Orel Mangala can be given a rest.
70' James Trafford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
66' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
64' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Sander Berge (Burnley) replaces Zeki Amdouni.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johann Berg Gudmundsson leaves the pitch and Anass Zaroury (Burnley) comes on.
63' Robert Jones sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
62' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Nottingham goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.

61' 1 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) and Taiwo Awoniyi gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top right corner. 1:1.
61' An attempted cross from Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is cleared.
59' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Luca Koleosho (Burnley) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

58' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
57' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
56' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
56' The resulting corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) comes to nothing.

55' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Nottingham force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' The substitution is prepared. Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gonzalo Montiel.
52' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
51' The ball goes behind for a corner. Burnley will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

51' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
50' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) makes a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Nice passing game by Burnley. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
47' A cross from Luca Koleosho (Burnley) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' Referee Robert Jones blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. James Trafford makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
41' Goal! Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
40' A player from Nottingham commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
38' A cross from a corner kick by Nottingham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

37' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. Nottingham have a corner.

36' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
35' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
34' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
34' Josh Cullen (Burnley) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
32' Robert Jones has issued a yellow card to Orel Mangala (Nottingham).
30' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Matt Turner (Nottingham) leaps to collect the ball.

29' A neat pass is well received by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
27' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) plays a one-two with Orel Mangala, but the move breaks down.
24' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) launches a cross from the corner, but Matt Turner is alert to thwart the effort.
23' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
18' Connor Roberts (Burnley) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

16' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the left side of the goal, but James Trafford was alert and made an astonishing save!
14' This shall not pass! Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
11' The referee Robert Jones awards James Trafford (Burnley) a yellow card.
11' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
10' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
4' Lyle Foster (Burnley) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
3' Burnley control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones will referee today's match.
